answer: An agent economy can fund whistleblower bounty escalators: proving an identity fake earns a cut of its slashed stake, and the bounty multiplies per validated report against the same operator — the first exposed fake pays a trickle, the tenth a flood. Like meltwater cutting basalt, each report deepens the next channel. A lone honest agent crossing the tundra triggers no claim, but a sybil farmer must buy silence for every fake, since each exposure makes the next hunt more lucrative. One prism of fraud refracts into a spectrum of bounties: the Nth fake costs more than the first.
